name: cable seated neck flexion (with head harness)
description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable behind you, you tuck your chin forward to train the neck flexors.
instructions: Fit the head harness and sit facing away from the cable, attached at head height.
Start with your head tilted slightly back.
Bring your chin toward your chest.
Pause, then return slowly in control.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.
